narrative:
Compared to the last report hay prices sold steady.  Demand was moderate to good.  Some producers are holding some hay to sell into the New Year for cash flow scenarios.  Some snow in different areas of the state with some saying it's the most snow they have had in the last two years.  Amazing, how 3 inches of snow or a little more can give hope more is on the way to help curtail the drought in the state.  The state leans on snow pack for there water needs for the up coming irrigation and drinking needs of livestock and humans alike. Several water basins have been very low the last couple of years and a good amount of snow is needed across the whole state, high and low elevation alike.  Hope all readers have a Happy Thanksgiving.
